upstream_provider.observation: Mutter configure_keyboard uses strlen(data), creates anonymous file with that byte length and passes fd,len to eis_device_new_keymap. The declared content excludes the C terminator. EI specifies keymap byte size, without a mandatory NUL rule.

original_regression.cause: read_keymap required a final NUL and NativeXkb unconditionally removed one byte. A valid length-delimited Mutter keymap was refused at actual FD copy before plan/packet construction.

contract.raw: Copy exactly declared bytes via original bounded pread/executor/FD, size1..1MiB and actual regular-file bounds/identity-before-after remain. Optional one terminal NUL accepted, internal NUL and full invalid UTF-8 refused. Shared offset remains untouched; bytes outside declared prefix are not keymap.
contract.identity: Stored data, KeymapInfo.size and SHA remain original raw bytes. Optional NUL is never appended/stripped in persisted observation or plan, so equivalent parsed content with different raw metadata cannot exchange identities.
contract.compile: Verify original raw bounds/hash first; strip only optional terminal NUL for parse content, reject empty/internal NUL/invalid UTF-8 before native context. C buffer gets its own sentinel and explicit complete text byte length. No dropped final byte, default layout, include search or extra key requests.
contract.tests: Both formats at1/1024/exact1MiB, backing suffix, UTF-8 final character, malformed suffix/internal NUL, identity substitution, injected C buffer content and full real-FD->plan->one-paired-frame transport. Original parser/state/cancellation/release/ownership caller tests remain.
contract.negative_contract_update: Two old negative fixtures incorrectly treated absent terminal NUL as malformed. They now test embedded NUL/trailing bytes, which remain invalid under the provider contract. UTF-8 copy does not claim syntax parsing; real XKB parser is still required.
